description: This Java source file implements the PublicKeyProvider interface in the context of JWT authentication for the Eclipse Ditto gateway security module. It manages retrieval and caching of public keys from OpenID Connect discovery endpoints, primarily utilizing HTTP requests, JSON processing, and caching mechanisms.

classes.name: DittoPublicKeyProvider
classes.description: A final class implementing PublicKeyProvider that handles the retrieval and caching of public keys for JWT verification, using HTTP discovery endpoints and a local cache.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate DittoPublicKeyProvider with specified configuration, HTTP client, cache settings, and name.

methods.name: getPublicKey
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a public key based on issuer and key ID, utilizing the cache.

methods.name: loadPublicKey
methods.description: Internal method to asynchronously load a public key from a discovery endpoint, given key ID and issuer.

methods.name: getDiscoveryEndpoint
methods.description: Constructs the OpenID Connect discovery endpoint URL based on issuer.

methods.name: mapResponseToJsonArray
methods.description: Parses HTTP response to extract the JSON array of keys.

methods.name: getPublicKeysFromDiscoveryEndpoint
methods.description: Fetches the JSON Web Key Set from the discovery URL.

methods.name: extractDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Transforms an ExecutionException into a DittoRuntimeException, providing context about the discovery endpoint.

methods.name: mapResponseToJsonObject
methods.description: Reads an HttpResponse and converts its body into a JsonObject.

methods.name: handleNonSuccessResponse
methods.description: Logs and throws exception when HTTP response indicates failure.

methods.name: getBodyAsString
methods.description: Extracts the response body as a string from an HttpResponse.

methods.name: handleUnexpectedException
methods.description: Logs and wraps exceptions during HTTP fetch procedures.

methods.name: mapToPublicKey
methods.description: Finds and constructs a PublicKey from a JSON Web Key array matching the specific key ID.
